opportunity: kuna emitted `goto label_X;` statements whose `label_X:` is absent from the same function -- output that does not compile (`gcc -fsyntax-only`: error: label 'label_X' used but not defined). Over 20 stripped binaries (O0/O2/O2-noinline; coreutils grep gzip bzip2 diffutils findutils tar shadow + an ARM32 betaflight image), 16,080 functions: 23 functions emitted 27 such gotos; over the 149 in-repo ELF fixtures (2,710 functions): 10 functions, 10 gotos.
test_name: tests/cli/emitted-goto-keeps-its-label.json (in-repo fixture datasyms_faillog_x86_64 @0x2620) + 4 unit tests in substrate/block/tests.rs
change_kind: strict correctness fix (no option: a goto without its label is invalid C)
root_cause: Three independent paths broke the label invariant. (1) gotoreduce/taildup/crossjumprevert each carried a private 'still referenced' census that saw only BlockGoto and BlockIf carriers, so a target a BlockSwitch case arm (or a BlockMultiGoto edge) still jumped to read as unreferenced and its label was released -- coreutils/sort O2 main, `default: goto label_661d;`. (2) mark_unstructured gated a BlockGoto's mark on goto_prints(), upstream's rule, but kuna's PrintC::emit_block_goto prints the trailing goto unconditionally (upstream's emitBlockGoto suppresses it under the same test), so a goto whose target was the next block in flow printed unlabelled -- grep O0 main. (3) the release compared the blocks carriers name while the label lives on the target's FRONT LEAF, so a surviving goto naming a BlockList and a converted one naming the BlockCopy that opens it were treated as different targets -- shadow/useradd O2 sub_16720.

corpus_scan.method: kuna decompile-all text, split per `// Function:` marker, a goto whose label line is absent from the same function (docs/features/gotolabel/orphan_scan.py)

corpus_diff.method: per-function before/after text diff, every changed function classified (docs/features/gotolabel/classify_diff.py, corpus-diff.txt)
corpus_diff.stripped_binaries: functions=16080 changed=23 added-label-only=20 other=3 (the 3 add the same label line plus the braces the printer puts around an `if` clause that is no longer a single statement); every changed function carried an orphan goto before, and no function without one changes

compile_check.method: gcc -fsyntax-only -w on each changed function's text, before vs after, with a shared synthesized typedef prelude (docs/features/gotolabel/gcc_check.py, gcc-check.txt)
compile_check.result: changed=23, and for all 23 the ONLY diagnostic removed is `error: label 'label_X' used but not defined` (27 in total); no new diagnostic appears on any of them

speed.method: interleaved back-to-back pairs on one pinned CPU, median of the per-pair ratio new/old (the box carried 3 concurrent test lanes; per-pair spread is +-5%, so min-of-N alone is not readable)

benchmark.typesweep: 444 slices / 10,748 functions, baseline-only with the fixed binary: type_match PERFECT 959 (main: 959), aggregate 3037.05 (mean 0.2826) -- unmoved
benchmark.why_it_cannot_move: the decbench-scored payload is `variables[]`; comparing old vs new `decompile-all --json` over sort O2, shadow/useradd O2, grep O0 and tar O2 (2,537 functions) the variables are identical field-for-field except `line_numbers`, which shift by one in the functions that gained a label line

gates.make test-stages: PARITY OK (1103/1103 assertions passed, no re-record)

notes: The only pinned expectation that moved is ghidra_sim_faillog_pins' PIN_FAILLOG_C_LINES[0] for sub_2620 (286 -> 287): that fixture function is one of the 10 orphan carriers, and the extra line is its restored `label_2701:`. No datatest or stage assertion moved. The redundant goto in cause (2) is deliberately left printed rather than suppressed under goto_prints(): dropping a statement is a structuring decision and would change functions that have no defect.
